findings.evidence: Phrase states 'Schools are ditching a search engine over AI features they cannot turn off,' but the source says schools 'are considering Google alternatives' (The Verge, title: 'school districts consider ditching Google'). The source describes a tentative, under-consideration move, not a completed/ongoing action.
findings.suggestion: Change phrase to reflect the source's tentativeness, e.g. 'Schools are considering ditching a search engine over AI features they cannot turn off.'
